description: Estimate ideal body weight from height and sex via four classic clinical formulas (Devine 1974, Robinson 1983, Miller 1983, Hamwi 1964), plus the healthy-BMI (18.5–24.9) weight band and current BMI for context. Needs age, sex, height, weight. Adult equations: ages 18 to 120. A younger age returns 400; for a child or teenager use myplate-plan or dri, whose energy equations have child forms. Above the healthy-BMI band, ideal_weight also carries firstGoal (the weights 5 to 10% under the current weight, the first goal in the 2013 AHA/ACC/TOS obesity guideline) and adjusted (the Hamwi ideal weight plus 25% of the weight above it). Both are null at or under the band, and in pregnancy and while breastfeeding. weight_loss_withheld gives the reason when they are withheld.

age.description: Age in years (18–120). These are adult equations; for a child or teenager use calculate_myplate_plan or calculate_dri.

height_cm.description: Height in centimeters (or use height_ft + height_in).

lactation.description: Breastfeeding status. Weight-loss figures are withheld while breastfeeding.

pregnancy.description: Pregnancy status. Weight-loss figures are withheld during pregnancy.

sex.description: Biological sex — drives the energy equation.
